fields.summary: The shipit work plan for task 9: genesis render, genesis check, genesis ci install, and Genesis checking its own committed .genesis/ in make check. Decided (D1-D14, agent wording accepted by the owner): render writes the as-is view only, an index page plus one page per live node at a handle path, retired nodes listed only in the index; render runs only when asked, and a stale render in check names genesis render as next; check fails on log read problems, fold problems other than concurrent lifecycle entries, as-is problems, link endpoint violations on live as-is links, stale rendered files and append-only violations, and only warns on concurrent entries and on problems that appear only in in-flight views; the append-only base is --base or the merge-base with origin/HEAD, origin/main or main, allowing only added files under .genesis/log and skipping the rule with a warning when there is no base; ci install writes a GitHub workflow and marks rendered/ as generated in .gitattributes, idempotently; Genesis's own .genesis/ is committed and make check runs check with a scratch binary, CI fetching full history; check always returns the full report and exits 1 only on a failure; node page layout; the link endpoint table in one table-tested place; any differing, missing or extra rendered file is stale; tests include golden rendered markdown, a determinism property and a corrupt-log fuzz target; guardrails keep core packages and writes untouched. Anchors and drift stayed out of milestone 1. Nothing left open in the plan.
fields.title: Shipit plan, milestone 1 task 9: integrity
